newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates fall, close at 21.25 to 21.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates fall, close at 21.25 to 21.5 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interbank interest rates ended down between 21.25 to 21.5 percent on Thursday after opening in a range between 21.625 and 21.875 percent, dealers said.
"It's a very liquid market," said Sandor Szatmari of Unicbank. "I expect rates to fall even further."
Dealers said rates could rise again at the end of the week as some banks may need money to fill reserves by the end of the two-week reserve period on Saturday.
